messages:
Alex (AE): Heads-up — Northwind just sent an RFI and wants an embeddings + gen POC alongside the RFP answers. Can SE + Security + SRE sync today? Key asks: POC schedule, pricing band for ~50M tokens/month POC, and clarifications on KMS/HSM and audit logs. I'll upload an initial capability matrix and draft answers in a sec.

Priya (SE): On it. Proposed POC plan: 2-week eval, integration with their test app + Dedicated pool for consistent latency. Need: sample dataset (anonymized), an SSO test account, and a brief acceptance criteria doc. Who will own the capability_matrix file?

Alex (AE): I'll upload the first pass. Pricing question: what's our committed rate guidance for 50M gen tokens + 2M embeddings? Also, Northwind asked about POC discounts and terms. Can pricing confirm quick?

Priya (SE): Quick draft pricing for discussion: hosted gen $0.0006/token, embeddings $0.0008/embedding. For a short POC we can offer a 40% POC discount on committed usage for the first 60 days, and recommend Dedicated for predictable perf if they want to test latency SLO. Need pricing signoff.

Devon (Security): Flagging RFI security items: key ownership (CMK/HSM), retention of audit logs, data residency, and SOC2/FedRAMP evidence. Note: we support customer-managed KMS for Private deployments; on-prem HSM integration is available via the Private package (legal + infra coord). Suggested wording below — please review and shorten as needed:
```
Redwood supports customer-managed encryption keys (CMK) via major cloud KMS providers (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) for hosted and Private deployments. For Private/on‑prem deployments we support HSM integrations where keys can be generated and controlled by the customer; Redwood does not export persistent key material from a customer’s HSM. Audit logs for admin and access events are configurable and can be retained per contract (standard retention 90 days, extended options available).
```

Priya (SE): That wording looks good. I’ll slot it into rfi_answers_draft.md and trim. Also adding a short section about our model catalog/verified performance and fallback routing policy.

Alex (AE): Uploaded: capability_matrix_v3.xlsx (link: https://files.redwood/example/capability_matrix_v3.xlsx) and rfi_answers_draft.md (link: https://files.redwood/example/rfi_answers_draft.md). Please reference the "Onprem/HSM" row — Northwind specifically called that out.

Sam (SRE): Confirming Dedicated capacity: we have a 3-GPU test pool available in us-west-2 for the week of 1718064000–1718150400. Suggest autoscale min=1 GPU, max=4 for the POC; we'll set a fallback route to hosted instances to avoid hard failures (with data marking). I'll draft a short runbook for the POC: deployment steps, escalation, and cost tracking.

Priya (SE): Thanks Sam — can you reserve the pool and share the runbook link? I'll add acceptance tests and the dataset upload instructions. Also, legal asked if we can sign a simple POC addendum; Alex, can you check with contracts?

Alex (AE): On contracts — I'll ping legal. Action items recap: Priya to finalize RFI answers (EOD), Devon to provide security evidence links (SOC2 report redacted + KMS integration notes), Sam to reserve Dedicated test pool and publish runbook, and I'll coordinate NDA/POC addendum and send to Northwind tomorrow AM.

POC-bot: Ticket created POC-4821 and assigned to Priya (SE). Due date: 1718080000.

Priya (SE): Will update ticket with the final RFI bundle and capability matrix once Devon's security blurbs are in. If anyone has short examples of wording for HSM integrations with legal-preferred phrasing, drop them here. :thumbsup:

Devon (Security): Dropping two evidence links for legal to use: https://vault.redwood/soc2/redacted and https://vault.redwood/kms-integration-guide (both require contract-level access). I'll also add a one-paragraph HSM summary that legal can paste.

Alex (AE): Solid. Let's aim to send the full RFI + POC plan to Northwind by tomorrow 09:00 PT. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
